about: Registry of the data splits behind the ledger rows. A split's first scoring may be held/fresh; every later use is dev, reused or explore. Data is not committed; `regenerate` says how to rebuild it.

henryiv-fr.what: Henry IV Part 1, English (Gutenberg) vs Guizot French, speeches aligned per scene, held out by act

henryiv-de.what: Henry IV Part 1, English vs Wieland German, aligned per act, held out by act

wiki-latin-dev.what: English/French and English/German Wikipedia lead pairs (countries, rivers, mountains, physicists, elements...), acts <= 3

mrpc-dev.what: last third of GLUE MRPC train (by idx)
mrpc-dev.regenerate: MRPC parquet from the GLUE dataset, see mrpc/mrpc.py

mrpc-test.regenerate: MRPC parquet from the GLUE dataset, see mrpc/mrpc.py

f1.what: fresh set 1: capitals by continent and US states, fr/de leads

f2.what: fresh set 2: administrative divisions (Italy, Japan, Switzerland, India, France, Argentina, Germany, Netherlands)

f3.what: fresh set 3: divisions (Thailand, Turkey, Greece, Romania, Iran, Italy regions, Vietnam, Egypt, Croatia, Hungary, Chile)

f4.what: fresh set 4: divisions (Philippines, Kenya, Afghanistan, Indonesia, Colombia, Mexico, Peru, Ukraine, Ghana, Senegal, Norway, Cuba)

f5.what: fresh set 5: divisions (Nigeria, Tanzania, Bulgaria, Ecuador, Madagascar, DR Congo, Papua New Guinea, Sweden, China, Iraq, Portugal, Estonia, Czech Republic, Laos, Honduras, Namibia), fr/de leads

f6.what: fresh set 6: divisions (Mongolia, Kazakhstan, Uruguay, Dominican Republic, Burkina Faso, Ethiopia, Uganda, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Liberia, Albania, Uzbekistan), fr/de leads; lead wikitext for the link targets via wikipedia/fetch_wt6.py

f7.what: fresh set 7: persons (Nobel laureates in Chemistry, Physiology or Medicine and Literature; Fields Medalists; Turing Award laureates) and places (Islands of Greece, Counties of Sweden, Provinces of Papua New Guinea, Counties of Estonia, Regions of Slovakia and Portugal, Cantons of Luxembourg, States of Malaysia), fr/de leads, never read before the single scoring of row 26

khora-div.what: 321 English Wikipedia leads (14 article groups, up to 40 per group, seed 20261118, from articles.json) read through khora, plus the English clause run run_2026-03-19_144302 of the eo-lexical-analysis-2.0 repo (3,590 clauses with Claude three-question labels)
khora-div.regenerate: wikipedia/fetch.py (articles.json), then khora-run/dump-triples.mjs; the clause corpus from github.com/clovenbradshaw-ctrl/eo-lexical-analysis-2.0
